name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
flavour_text: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur

1.name: Mega Drain
1.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

2.name: Giant Bloom
2.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

name: Caterpie

1.name: Find a Friend
1.effect: Put 1 random [G] Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Metapod
flavour_text: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

name: Butterfree

ability.name: Powder Heal
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

flavour_text: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Weedle
flavour_text: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
flavour_text: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Beedrill
flavour_text: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

name: Oddish
flavour_text: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavour_text: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Vileplume

1.name: Soothing Scent
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Paras
flavour_text: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Parasect
flavour_text: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

name: Venonat
flavour_text: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

name: Venomoth

1.name: Poison Powder
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Bellsprout
flavour_text: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
flavour_text: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel

ability.name: Fragrance Trap
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, once during your turn, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot.

flavour_text: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Exeggcute
flavour_text: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor

1.name: Stomp
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.

1.name: Tropical Swing
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

name: Tangela

1.name: Absorb
1.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Scyther
flavour_text: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Pinsir

1.name: Double Horn
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Cottonee
flavour_text: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Whimsicott
flavour_text: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it’ll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

name: Petilil

1.name: Blot
1.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

name: Lilligant

1.name: Leaf Supply
1.effect: Take a [G] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched [G] Pokémon.

flavour_text: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

name: Skiddo

1.name: Surprise Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the backs of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

name: Gogoat
flavour_text: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

name: Charmander

1.name: Ember
1.effect: Discard a [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

name: Charizard

1.name: Fire Spin
1.effect: Discard 2 [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

2.name: Crimson Storm
2.effect: Discard 2 [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Vulpix

1.name: Tail Whip
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

flavour_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales

1.name: Flamethrower
1.effect: Discard a [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine

1.name: Heat Tackle
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

1.name: Inferno Onrush
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

name: Ponyta
flavour_text: It can’t run properly when it’s newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

name: Rapidash
flavour_text: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Magmar
flavour_text: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Flareon

1.name: Flamethrower
1.effect: Discard 1 [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Moltres

1.name: Sky Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

1.name: Inferno Dance
1.effect: Flip 3 coins. Take an amount of [R] Energy from your Energy Zone equal to the number of heads and attach it to your Benched [R] Pokémon in any way you like.

name: Heatmor
flavour_text: There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Salandit
flavour_text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
flavour_text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Sizzlipede
flavour_text: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch

1.name: Fire Blast
1.effect: Discard a [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
flavour_text: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Blastoise

1.name: Hydro Pump
1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [W] Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

2.name: Hydro Bazooka
2.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [W] Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Psyduck

1.name: Headache
1.effect: Your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.

flavour_text: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
flavour_text: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Poliwag
flavour_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavour_text: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Poliwrath

ability.name: Counterattack
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

name: Tentacool
flavour_text: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.

name: Tentacruel

1.name: Poison Tentacles
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

name: Seel
flavour_text: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don’t bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Dewgong
flavour_text: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

name: Shellder
flavour_text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster

ability.name: Shell Armor
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Krabby
flavour_text: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

name: Kingler

1.name: KO Crab
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavour_text: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Horsea
flavour_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra

1.name: Water Arrow
1.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

name: Goldeen
flavour_text: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

name: Seaking

1.name: Horn Hazard
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

name: Staryu
flavour_text: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Starmie
flavour_text: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Magikarp
flavour_text: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados

1.name: Hyper Beam
1.effect: Discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Lapras

1.name: Hydro Pump
1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra [W] Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavour_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Vaporeon

1.name: Bubble Drain
1.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

name: Omanyte
flavour_text: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

name: Omastar

1.name: Ancient Whirlpool
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

flavour_text: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

name: Articuno

1.name: Ice Beam
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

2.name: Blizzard
2.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Ducklett
flavour_text: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna
flavour_text: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Froakie
flavour_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
flavour_text: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja

ability.name: Water Shuriken
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may do 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Pyukumuku
flavour_text: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Bruxish

1.name: Second Strike
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

name: Snom
flavour_text: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

name: Frosmoth

1.name: Powder Snow
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Raichu

1.name: Thunderbolt
1.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

1.name: Circle Circuit
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched [L] Pokémon.

name: Magnemite
flavour_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton

ability.name: Volt Charge
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may take a [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Voltorb
flavour_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavour_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Electabuzz

1.name: Thunder Punch
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

name: Jolteon

1.name: Pin Missile
1.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Zapdos

1.name: Raging Thunder
1.effect: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

2.name: Thundering Hurricane
2.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

name: Blitzle
flavour_text: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Zebstrika

1.name: Thunder Spear
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Tynamo
flavour_text: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavour_text: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross

1.name: Thunder Fang
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Helioptile
flavour_text: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon’s electric moves.

name: Heliolisk

1.name: Quick Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Pincurchin

1.name: Thunder Shock
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavour_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Abra

1.name: Teleport
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

name: Kadabra
flavour_text: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

name: Alakazam

1.name: Psychic
1.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowbro
flavour_text: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Gengar

1.name: Bother
1.effect: Your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.

flavour_text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

ability.name: Shadowy Spellbind
ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand.

name: Drowzee
flavour_text: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.

name: Hypno

ability.name: Sleep Pendulum
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

name: Mr. Mime

1.name: Barrier Attack
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes -20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Jynx

1.name: Psychic
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Mewtwo

1.name: Power Blast
1.effect: Discard 2 [P] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

2.name: Psydrive
2.effect: Discard 2 [P] Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

name: Kirlia
flavour_text: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir

ability.name: Psy Shadow
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may take 1 [P] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to the [P] Pokémon in the Active Spot.

flavour_text: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Woobat
flavour_text: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s evidence that Woobat live there.

name: Swoobat
flavour_text: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a little while.

name: Golett
flavour_text: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

name: Golurk

1.name: Double Lariat
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

name: Sandshrew
flavour_text: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.

name: Sandslash
flavour_text: The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokémon’s spikes will feel when touched.

name: Diglett
flavour_text: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Dugtrio

1.name: Dig
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

name: Mankey
flavour_text: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Primeape

1.name: Fight Back
1.effect: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

name: Machop
flavour_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavour_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Geodude
flavour_text: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they’re totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

name: Graveler
flavour_text: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

name: Golem

1.name: Double-Edge
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

flavour_text: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

name: Onix
flavour_text: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Cubone

1.name: Growl
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do -20 damage.

flavour_text: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Marowak
flavour_text: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

1.name: Bonemerang
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

name: Hitmonlee

1.name: Stretch Kick
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

name: Hitmonchan
flavour_text: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

name: Rhyhorn
flavour_text: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

name: Rhydon
flavour_text: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

name: Kabuto
flavour_text: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

name: Kabutops

1.name: Leech Life
1.effect: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

name: Mienfoo
flavour_text: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

name: Mienshao
flavour_text: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

name: Clobbopus
flavour_text: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Grapploct

1.name: Knock Back
1.effect: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavour_text: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Ekans
flavour_text: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok

1.name: Corner

name: Charmander

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

name: Magmar

1.name: Blaze Tackle

name: Tentacool

name: Tentacruel
flavour_text: When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

name: Buizel

flavour_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

flavour_text: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavour_text: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot

flavour_text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Abra
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

name: Kadabra
flavour_text: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

name: Alakazam

1.name: Psychic Suppression
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any Energy attached.

flavour_text: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Mr. Mime

1.name: Juggling
1.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Drifloon
flavour_text: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Drifblim
flavour_text: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

1.name: Chest-ouflage

flavour_text: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: Machop
flavour_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke

1.name: Pummel
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp

1.name: Power Press
1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [F] Energy attached, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Hitmonlee
flavour_text: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

name: Hitmonchan
flavour_text: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

name: Riolu
flavour_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

1.name: Aura Sphere
1.effect: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Flamigo

1.name: Double Kick
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

name: Ekans
flavour_text: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok

flavour_text: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Alolan Exeggutor

1.name: Tropical Hammer
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: Blazing sunlight has brought out the true form and powers of this Pokémon.

name: Surskit

1.name: Quick Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavour_text: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

flavour_text: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

name: Maractus
flavour_text: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

name: Karrablast
flavour_text: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Phantump
flavour_text: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit’s rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Trevenant
flavour_text: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.

name: Rowlet
flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Rowlet

1.name: Skill Dive
1.effect: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavour_text: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don’t groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

1.name: Pierce the Pain
1.effect: This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that have damage on them.

name: Grubbin
flavour_text: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

name: Fomantis
flavour_text: Fomantis hates having its naps interrupted. It fires off beams using energy it gathers by bathing in the sun.

name: Lurantis

1.name: Petal Blizzard
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down.

name: Morelull
flavour_text: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull’s head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Shiinotic

1.name: Flickering Light
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

flavour_text: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Bounsweet
flavour_text: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee

1.name: Double Spin
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena

1.name: Three Kick Combo
1.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Wimpod

ability.name: Wimp Out
ability.effect: During your first turn, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

flavour_text: It’s nature’s cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod

1.name: First Impression
1.effect: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

1.name: Anchor Shot
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Tapu Bulu

1.name: Stuck-In Tackle
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, it’s violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavour_text: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

name: Alolan Marowak

1.name: Burning Bonemerang
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads. If at least 1 of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavour_text: This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and dances through the night as a way to mourn its fallen allies.

name: Fletchinder
flavour_text: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

name: Talonflame
flavour_text: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs.

name: Litten

1.name: Heat Tackle
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Litten
flavour_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat

1.name: Heat Tackle
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they’ve grown close, but it’s a powerful, sharp-clawed Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

1.name: Fire Fang
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

2.name: Scar-Charged Smash
2.effect: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Oricorio

1.name: Kindle
1.effect: Discard a random Energy from both Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

name: Salandit
flavour_text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle

1.name: Heated Poison
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Burned.

flavour_text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Turtonator

1.name: Fire Spin
1.effect: Discard a [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavour_text: Life on mountains covered with deep snow has granted this Pokémon a body of ice that’s as hard as steel.

name: Alolan Sandslash

1.name: Spike Armor
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack, do 40 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavour_text: It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this Sandslash is faster than any other Pokémon.

name: Alolan Vulpix

1.name: Call Forth Cold
1.effect: Take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: After long years in the ever-snowcapped mountains of Alola, this Vulpix has gained power over ice.

name: Alolan Ninetales

1.name: Blizzard
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: A deity resides in the snowy mountains where this Pokémon lives. In ancient times, it was worshiped as that deity’s incarnation.

name: Shellder
flavour_text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster

1.name: Guard Press
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Lapras
flavour_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Popplio

1.name: Sing
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Popplio
flavour_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavour_text: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn’t know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Primarina

ability.name: Melodious Healing
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 30 damage from each of your [W] Pokémon.

flavour_text: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.

1.name: Insatiable Striking
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Insatiable Striking attack does +40 damage.

name: Wishiwashi

1.name: Call for Family
1.effect: Put 1 random Wishiwashi or Wishiwashi ex from your deck onto your Bench.

flavour_text: Individually, they’re incredibly weak. It’s by gathering up into schools that they’re able to confront opponents.

1.name: School Storm
1.effect: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Benched Wishiwashi or Wishiwashi ex.

name: Dewpider
flavour_text: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

name: Araquanid

1.name: Dangerous Claws
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokemon, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Pyukumuku

ability.name: Innards Out
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 50 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavour_text: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Bruxish
flavour_text: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

name: Tapu Fini

1.name: Spiral Drain
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

1.name: Psychic
1.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavour_text: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavour_text: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the “fireworks of the earth.”

name: Alolan Golem

1.name: Super Zap Cannon
1.effect: Discard 2 [L] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

name: Helioptile
flavour_text: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon’s electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Charjabug
flavour_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt

1.name: Disconnect
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

flavour_text: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Oricorio

ability.name: Safeguard
ability.effect: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex.

flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

name: Togedemaru

1.name: Electrosmash
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Tapu Koko

1.name: Volt Switch
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched [L] Pokémon.

flavour_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Mr. Mime

1.name: Barrier Shove
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Sableye

1.name: Corner
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Spoink

1.name: Psycharge
1.effect: Take a [P] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

name: Grumpig
flavour_text: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Lunatone
flavour_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It’s active on the night of a full moon.

name: Shuppet
flavour_text: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

name: Banette

1.name: Night Bind
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't take any Energy from their Energy Zone to attach to their Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Oricorio

1.name: Dazzle Dance
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.

name: Oricorio

1.name: Spiteful Dance
1.effect: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. It uses ethereal dance steps to call forth the spirits of the dead.

name: Cutiefly
flavour_text: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.

name: Ribombee
flavour_text: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs’ effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

name: Comfey

ability.name: Flower Shield
ability.effect: Each of your Pokémon that has any [P] Energy attached recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

flavour_text: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won’t wither once they’re attached to a Comfey.

name: Sandygast
flavour_text: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else—like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Palossand
flavour_text: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

name: Mimikyu

1.name: Shadow Hit
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your Pokémon.

flavour_text: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Tapu Lele

1.name: Energy Arrow
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy attached to that Pokémon.

flavour_text: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

name: Cosmog

1.name: Teleport
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn’t seem to care.

name: Cosmoem

1.name: Stiffen
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −50 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the “cocoon of the stars” and built an altar to worship it.

ability.name: Psychic Connect
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may move all [P] Energy from 1 of your Benched [P] Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

name: Necrozma

1.name: Prismatic Laser
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

flavour_text: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It’s apparently from another world.

name: Cubone
flavour_text: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Makuhita
flavour_text: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

name: Hariyama

1.name: Push Out
1.effect: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavour_text: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Solrock
flavour_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Drilbur
flavour_text: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

name: Timburr
flavour_text: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

name: Gurdurr
flavour_text: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

name: Conkeldurr

ability.name: Guts
ability.effect: If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

flavour_text: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

name: Crabrawler
flavour_text: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

name: Rockruff

1.name: Signs of Evolution
1.effect: Put a random card that evolves from Rockruff from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Lycanroc

1.name: Crunch
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

name: Lycanroc

1.name: Blood Fang
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has more remaining HP than this Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

name: Mudbray
flavour_text: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won’t dry out even if it’s exposed to the sun for a long time.

name: Mudsdale

1.name: High Horsepower
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 40 damage to itself.

flavour_text: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

ability.name: Offload Pass
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, move all [F] Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Minior

1.name: Star Drop
1.effect: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.

name: Alolan Rattata
flavour_text: It shows no interest in anything that isn’t fresh. If you take it shopping with you, it will help you pick out ingredients.

name: Alolan Raticate

1.name: Scrounge-and-Scarf
1.effect: Discard a random Item card from your opponent's hand.

flavour_text: It has an incredibly greedy personality. Its nest is filled with so much food gathered by Rattata at its direction, it can’t possibly eat it all.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavour_text: It’s accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it’s very picky about food.

name: Alolan Persian

ability.name: Fur Coat
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: The round face of Alolan Persian is considered to be a symbol of prosperity in the Alola region, so these Pokémon are very well cared for.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavour_text: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola’s waste-disposal site. They’re all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

1.name: Chemical Panic
1.effect: 1 Special Condition from among Asleep, Burned, Confused, Paralyzed, and Poisoned is chosen at random, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. Any Special Conditions already affecting that Pokémon will not be chosen.

name: Absol

1.name: Unseen Claw
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Trubbish
flavour_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor

1.name: Super Poison Breath
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Mareanie
flavour_text: This Pokémon wanders the seaside looking for food. It often gets electric shocks from broken Pincurchin spines that it tries to eat.

name: Toxapex

1.name: Spike Cannon
1.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: This Pokémon lives within a dome made by its own legs. Toxapex monitors its surroundings by sensing the flow of the tide through its spikes.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavour_text: The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon’s habitat caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

name: Alolan Dugtrio

1.name: Iron Head
1.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: Their beautiful, metallic whiskers create a sort of protective helmet on their heads, and they also function as highly precise sensors.

name: Excadrill
flavour_text: It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill’s rampant digging.

name: Escavalier

1.name: Pike
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Klefki

1.name: Unlock
1.effect: Draw a card.

flavour_text: Once it absorbs a key’s metal ions, it discards the key without a second thought. However, it will hang on to keys it favors for decades.

ability.name: Rising Road
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon.

1.name: Sol Breaker
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Magearna

1.name: Silver Cannon
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has an Ability, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.

name: Drampa

1.name: Berserk
1.effect: If any of your Benched Pokémon have damage on them, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Jangmo-o
flavour_text: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

name: Hakamo-o
flavour_text: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.

name: Kommo-o

1.name: Clanging Scales
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes +30 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.

name: Tauros

1.name: Rising Lunge
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

name: Skitty
flavour_text: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty

1.name: Energy Assist
1.effect: Take a [C] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Fletchling
flavour_text: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

name: Hawlucha

1.name: Justified Press
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a [D] Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

name: Pikipek
flavour_text: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

name: Trumbeak
flavour_text: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.

name: Toucannon
flavour_text: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

name: Yungoos
flavour_text: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

name: Gumshoos
flavour_text: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

name: Stufful
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear

1.name: Tantrum
1.effect: This Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Oranguru

1.name: Primate’s Trap
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 1 [C] more, and its Retreat Cost is 1 [C] more.

flavour_text: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

name: Komala

ability.name: Comatose
ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever you attach an Energy from your Energy Zone to it, it is now Asleep.

flavour_text: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

name: Big Malasada

name: Fishing Net
card_text: Put a random Basic [ W ] Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Rare Candy

name: Rotom Dex
card_text: Look at the top card of your deck. Then, you may shuffle your deck.

name: Poison Barb
card_text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Leaf Cape
card_text: The [ G ] Pokémon this card is attached to gets +30 HP.

name: Acerola
card_text: Choose 1 of your Palossand or Mimikyu that has damage on it, and move 40 of its damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Ilima
card_text: Put 1 of your [ C ] Pokémon that has damage on it into your hand.

name: Kiawe
card_text: Choose 1 of your Alolan Marowak or Turtonator. Take 2 [ R ] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to that Pokémon. Your turn ends.

name: Guzma
card_text: Discard all Pokémon Tool cards attached to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Lana
card_text: You can use this card only if you have Araquanid in play. Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

name: Sophocles
card_text: During this turn, attacks used by your Alolan Golem, Vikavolt, or Togedemaru do +30 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Mallow
card_text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Shiinotic or Tsareena. If you do, discard all Energy from that Pokémon.
