name: Chikorita
flavour_text: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

name: Bayleef
flavour_text: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: Meganium

1.name: Bloomshine
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

flavour_text: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

name: Ledyba
flavour_text: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
flavour_text: It’s said that the patterns on its back are related to the stars in the night sky, but the details of that relationship remain unclear.

name: Hoppip
flavour_text: Outside of cold regions, Hoppip can be found practically everywhere. This is because the wind carries this species all over the world.

name: Skiploom
flavour_text: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon’s head.

name: Jumpluff

ability.name: Fluffy Flight
ability.effect: Your Active Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

flavour_text: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

name: Sunkern

1.name: Blot
1.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it’s weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.

name: Sunflora
flavour_text: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

name: Yanma

1.name: U-turn
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Yanmega
flavour_text: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

name: Pineco
flavour_text: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

ability.name: Solid Shell
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

1.name: Triple Slap
1.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

name: Heracross

1.name: Single Lunge
1.effect: If this Pokémon has no damage on it, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

name: Cherubi

ability.name: En-fruits-iastic
ability.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, attacks used by this Pokémon cost 1 less [G] Energy.

1.name: Sweets Relay
1.effect: If 1 of your Pokémon used Sweets Relay during your last turn, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavour_text: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

name: Cherrim
flavour_text: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It’s full of energy while it’s like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

name: Vulpix
flavour_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales

1.name: Scorching Breath
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

flavour_text: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Cyndaquil
flavour_text: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: Quilava
flavour_text: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

name: Typhlosion

ability.name: Fire Breath
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned.

flavour_text: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

name: Slugma
flavour_text: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo

1.name: Spurt Fire
1.effect: 1 other Pokémon (either yours or your opponent's) is chosen at random 3 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 50 damage to it.

flavour_text: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Magby

1.name: Toasty Toss
1.effect: Take a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is still small and timid. Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised, flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

name: Entei

1.name: Strong Flare
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 random Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

1.name: Phoenix Turbo
1.effect: Take a [R], [W], and [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach them to your Benched Basic Pokémon in any way you like.

name: Darumaka
flavour_text: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

name: Darmanitan
flavour_text: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

name: Heatmor

1.name: Roasting Heat
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Burned, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Poliwag
flavour_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavour_text: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Politoed

ability.name: Lordly Cheering
ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, attacks used by your Pokémon that evolve from Poliwhirl do +40 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

name: Horsea
flavour_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra
flavour_text: It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

1.name: Stormy Prison
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Magikarp

1.name: Splashing Dodge
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados

1.name: Wild Swing
1.effect: You may discard any number of your Benched [W] Pokémon. This attack does 40 more damage for each Benched Pokémon you discarded in this way.

flavour_text: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Totodile
flavour_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
flavour_text: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr

1.name: Destructive Whirlpool
1.effect: Discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Marill
flavour_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill

ability.name: Thick Fat
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks from [R] or [W] Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Wooper
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
flavour_text: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Qwilfish

1.name: Poison Sting
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: Be cautious if this Pokémon starts sucking in water—it will soon attack by scattering the toxic spikes that grow all over its body.

name: Corsola

1.name: Find a Friend
1.effect: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

name: Remoraid
flavour_text: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery

1.name: Octazooka
1.effect: If the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen. This effect lasts until the Defending Pokémon leaves the Active Spot, and it doesn't stack.

flavour_text: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

name: Delibird

1.name: Stumbling Draw
1.effect: Draw a card.

flavour_text: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

name: Mantine

1.name: Dive
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

name: Suicune

1.name: Cure Stream
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do −20 damage.

flavour_text: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Corphish
flavour_text: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Crawdaunt

ability.name: Unruly Claw
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: Ducklett
flavour_text: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna

1.name: Feathery Cyclone
1.effect: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Chinchou
flavour_text: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

1.name: Flashing Signal
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Pichu

1.name: Crackly Toss
1.effect: Take a [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

name: Mareep
flavour_text: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

name: Flaaffy
flavour_text: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

name: Ampharos

1.name: Thunder Punch
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

name: Elekid

1.name: Zappy Shot
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: When a storm approaches, this Pokémon gets restless. Once Elekid hears the sound of thunder, it gets full-on rowdy.

name: Raikou

1.name: Thunder
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: Emolga

1.name: Raging Thunder
1.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Slowpoke

1.name: Rest
1.effect: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it.

flavour_text: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowking

1.name: Psychic
1.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Smoochum

1.name: Shivery Wave
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn’t really seem to care.

name: Jynx

1.name: Attract Smack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Cleffa

1.name: Twinkly Call
1.effect: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.

name: Togepi

1.name: Charm
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do −20 damage.

flavour_text: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
flavour_text: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss

ability.name: Celestial Blessing
ability.effect: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

flavour_text: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Natu
flavour_text: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

name: Xatu

1.name: Life Drain
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon's remaining HP is now 10.

flavour_text: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

ability.name: Psychic Healing
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Unown

ability.name: GUARD
ability.effect: This Ability works if you have any Unown in play with an Ability other than GUARD. All of your Pokémon take −10 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Unown

ability.name: POWER
ability.effect: This Ability works if you have any Unown in play with an Ability other than POWER. Attacks used by your Pokémon do +10 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Wobbuffet

1.name: Reply Strongly
1.effect: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn while it was in the Active Spot, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

name: Girafarig

1.name: Psybeam
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: Girafarig’s tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.

name: Snubbull
flavour_text: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

name: Granbull

1.name: Wild Tackle
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: While it has powerful jaws, it doesn’t care for disputes, so it rarely has a chance to display their might.

name: Munna
flavour_text: Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.

name: Musharna

1.name: Dream Dance
1.effect: Both Active Pokémon are now Asleep.

flavour_text: When dark mists emanate from its body, don’t get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.

name: Onix
flavour_text: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Sudowoodo
flavour_text: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

name: Gligar
flavour_text: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavour_text: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Swinub
flavour_text: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Piloswine
flavour_text: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Mamoswine

1.name: Earthquake
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

name: Phanpy

1.name: Reckless Charge
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

1.name: Gigantic Press
1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [F] Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Tyrogue
flavour_text: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Hitmontop

1.name: Piercing Spin
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Larvitar
flavour_text: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

name: Pupitar

1.name: Guard Press
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

name: Binacle

1.name: Dual Chop
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

name: Barbaracle
flavour_text: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Zubat

1.name: Venomous Fang
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat

1.name: Venomous Fang
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: It loves to drink other creatures’ blood. It’s said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it’s gathered.

1.name: Venomous Slash
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Spinarak
flavour_text: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

name: Ariados

1.name: Bind Down
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.

ability.name: Dark Chase
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it to the Active Spot.

name: Murkrow

1.name: Astonish
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent reveals a random card from their hand and shuffles it into their deck.

flavour_text: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow
flavour_text: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Sneasel
flavour_text: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Weavile
flavour_text: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Houndour
flavour_text: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom

1.name: Diving Swipe
1.effect: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

flavour_text: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: Tyranitar

ability.name: Energy Plunder
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may move all [D] Energy from each of your Pokémon to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn’t care about others.

name: Absol

1.name: Leap Over
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Forretress
flavour_text: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Steelix
flavour_text: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Scizor

1.name: Gale Thrust
1.effect: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

1.name: Steel Wing
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Klink
flavour_text: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavour_text: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon’s rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang

1.name: Gear Spinner
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Gear Spinner attack does +70 damage.

flavour_text: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Spearow
flavour_text: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

name: Fearow

1.name: Peck Bugs
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a [G] Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: Carrying food through Fearow’s territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Chansey

1.name: Scrunch
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

flavour_text: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Blissey

1.name: Energy Blow
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

name: Kangaskhan

1.name: Cross-Cut
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

name: Eevee

1.name: Find a Friend
1.effect: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Porygon
flavour_text: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2

ability.name: Buggy Evolution
ability.effect: Whenever you attach an Energy from your Energy Zone to this Pokémon, put a random card from your deck that evolves from this Pokémon onto this Pokémon to evolve it.

flavour_text: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

name: Porygon-Z

1.name: Slowing Beam
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 1 [C] more.

flavour_text: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.

name: Sentret
flavour_text: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.

name: Furret

1.name: Tail Smash
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

name: Hoothoot

ability.name: Insomnia
ability.effect: This Pokémon can't be Asleep.

flavour_text: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl

1.name: Fly
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Aipom

1.name: Imitate
1.effect: Draw cards until you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent.

flavour_text: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavour_text: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that’s proof it really likes you.

name: Dunsparce

1.name: Sudden Flash
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

name: Teddiursa

1.name: Honey Snack
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its paws are soaked in oodles of honey. When nervous, Teddiursa will lick its paws and soon have a smile back on its face.

name: Ursaring

1.name: Swing Around
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

flavour_text: It usually wears a hardened expression, but when it’s licking up honey—which it loves—the joy it feels will cause it to break into a wide grin.

name: Stantler

1.name: Enhanced Horns
1.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon apparently used to live in much harsher environments, and thus it once had stronger psychic powers than it does now.

name: Smeargle

1.name: Splatter Coating
1.effect: Change the type of a random Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of the following at random: [G], [R], [W], [L], [P], [F], [D], or [M].

flavour_text: The fluid of Smeargle’s tail secretions changes in the intensity of its hue as the Pokémon’s emotions change.

1.name: Elemental Blast
1.effect: Discard a [R], [W], and [L] Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Bouffalant

1.name: Continuous Headbutt
1.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

name: Elemental Switch
card_text: Move a [ R ] , [ W ] , or [ L ] Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

name: Squirt Bottle

flavour_text: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Ludicolo

1.name: Rhythmic Steps
1.effect: If you have exactly 1, 3, or 5 cards in your hand, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Wailmer
flavour_text: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Wailord

1.name: Whale Pump
1.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each [W] Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

name: Corphish
flavour_text: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

name: Crawdaunt
flavour_text: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

name: Luvdisc

1.name: Paired Tackle
1.effect: If you have exactly 2, 4, or 6 cards in your hand, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

name: Panpour
flavour_text: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour

1.name: Fury Swipes
1.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Tympole
flavour_text: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

name: Palpitoad
flavour_text: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Seismitoad

1.name: Split Spiral Punch
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Tirtouga
flavour_text: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

name: Carracosta

1.name: Blocking Shell
1.effect: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

flavour_text: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

name: Frillish
flavour_text: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Jellicent

ability.name: Bouncy Body
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Keldeo

1.name: Sacred Sword
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword.

flavour_text: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Froakie
flavour_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier

1.name: Bounce
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

ability.name: Shifting Stream
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may switch your Active [W] Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Bergmite
flavour_text: They live in mountainous regions of frigid cold. On rare occasions, they ride on the back of an Avalugg to cross seas and move to new habitats.

name: Avalugg

1.name: Frost Barrier
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its massive icy body to flatten anything that gets in its way. When it’s floating out on the ocean, it looks exactly like drift ice.

name: Chewtle
flavour_text: A popular game among children is to lift up sticks that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose Chewtle can hang on the longest.

name: Drednaw

1.name: Jaw Lock
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck out and chomps down on them.

name: Arrokuda
flavour_text: It takes down prey by charging into them with its hard, pointed jaw. But Arrokuda’s eyesight is poor, so this tactic has a low success rate.

name: Barraskewda

1.name: Double-Edge
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Eiscue

ability.name: Ice Face
ability.effect: If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes −40 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: If you lick the ice covering its face, you’ll find it has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on ocean currents from a cold, faraway land.

ability.name: Electromagnetic Wall
ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy from their Energy Zone to 1 of their Pokémon, do 20 damage to that Pokémon.

name: Mareep
flavour_text: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Flaaffy
flavour_text: Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

name: Ampharos

1.name: Zapping Bullet
1.effect: 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon is chosen at random. This attack also does 20 damage to it.

flavour_text: When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean’s surface.

1.name: Lightning Lancer
1.effect: 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon is chosen at random 3 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, also do 20 damage to it.

name: Shinx
flavour_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavour_text: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

name: Luxray

1.name: Flash Impact
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

name: Pachirisu

1.name: Attack the Wound
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Blitzle
flavour_text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavour_text: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Joltik
flavour_text: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’t produce a charge on its own.

name: Galvantula
flavour_text: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

name: Dedenne

1.name: Electric Nibbling
1.effect: Discard a [L] Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Dedenne emit electrical waves from the whiskers on their cheeks to communicate with each other. When low on electricity, they curl up and sleep.

name: Yamper

1.name: Roar
1.effect: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavour_text: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
flavour_text: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Natu
flavour_text: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

name: Xatu
flavour_text: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

name: Misdreavus

1.name: Double Spin
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Mismagius
flavour_text: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Sableye

1.name: Dirty Throw
1.effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.

1.name: Mega Harmony
1.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Duskull

1.name: Ambush
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

name: Dusclops
flavour_text: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

name: Dusknoir

ability.name: Fade into Darkness
ability.effect: When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't get any points for it.

flavour_text: With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir swallows its target whole. The soul is the only thing eaten— Dusknoir disgorges the body before departing.

name: Jirachi

1.name: Star Drop
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Drifloon

1.name: Wind Blast
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “signpost for wandering spirits.”

name: Drifblim

1.name: Balloon Barrage
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can’t be a fixed destination.

name: Chingling

1.name: Jingly Noise
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

flavour_text: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

name: Yamask
flavour_text: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Cofagrigus

1.name: Soul Shot
1.effect: Discard 2 cards from your hand. If you can't discard 2 cards, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

name: Gothita
flavour_text: Beware of touching the ribbon-shaped feelers that control its psychic power. Gothita will begin bawling if you do.

name: Gothorita
flavour_text: Using its psychic power, it arranges pebbles to form the shapes of constellations. Some people believe this Pokémon came from outer space.

name: Gothitelle

1.name: Stellar Cradle
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if they attach Energy from their Energy Zone to the Defending Pokémon, that Pokémon will be Asleep.

flavour_text: It gazes at the stars to predict the future. It acts somewhat detached because it has seen the end of all existence.

name: Spritzee
flavour_text: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

name: Aromatisse

1.name: Confounding Cologne
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

name: Swirlix

1.name: Cotton Guard
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

name: Slurpuff

1.name: Draining Kiss
1.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

name: Carbink

1.name: Guard Press
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

name: Klefki

ability.name: Dismantling Keys
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If you do, discard this Pokémon.

flavour_text: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

ability.name: Watch Over
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon.

1.name: Psychic
1.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Sandshrew
flavour_text: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandslash
flavour_text: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

1.name: Quick Straight
1.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

name: Sudowoodo

1.name: Fight Back
1.effect: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

name: Makuhita
flavour_text: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama

1.name: Slapping Knockdown
1.effect: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Hippopotas
flavour_text: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.

name: Hippowdon

1.name: Crashing Fangs
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

flavour_text: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

name: Sandile
flavour_text: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok
flavour_text: Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the middle of the night.

name: Krookodile

1.name: Chomp Chomp Bite
1.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

name: Archen
flavour_text: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

name: Archeops

1.name: Wild Spin
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon's Wild Spin attack does +20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

name: Golett
flavour_text: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Golurk

1.name: Heavy Rocket
1.effect: Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. This attack does 60 damage for each Pokémon with a Retreat Cost of 3 or more you find there. Shuffle the revealed cards back into your deck.

flavour_text: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

name: Terrakion

1.name: Sacred Sword
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword.

flavour_text: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

name: Pancham
flavour_text: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Crabrawler
flavour_text: If it loses its pincers, they’ll quickly regrow. The pincers are popular ingredients in paella since their shells produce a tasty soup stock.

name: Crabominable

1.name: Last-Chance Punch
1.effect: If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 30 or less, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: Though its punches are powerful, this Pokémon’s movements are sluggish. It blows icy bubbles from its mouth to immobilize its opponents.

name: Stufful
flavour_text: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
flavour_text: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Sandygast

1.name: Sand Attack
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

flavour_text: It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to close in on them while they’re blinded, but since Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.

name: Palossand

1.name: Life Sucker
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones of its victims, which are all dried up after being drained of their vitality.

name: Rolycoly
flavour_text: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon’s body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

name: Carkol
flavour_text: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

name: Coalossal

1.name: Coal Drop
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a [G] Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: It’s gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

name: Murkrow
flavour_text: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

name: Honchkrow

1.name: Evil Admonition
1.effect: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon in play that has an Ability.

flavour_text: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

name: Absol

1.name: Ominous Claw
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a Supporter card you find there and discard it.

flavour_text: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

1.name: Darkness Claw
1.effect: Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a Supporter card you find there and discard it.

name: Skorupi
flavour_text: It attacks using the claws on its tail. Once locked in its grip, its prey is unable to move as this Pokémon’s poison seeps in.

name: Drapion

1.name: Stun Poison
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Paralyzed.

flavour_text: It’s so vicious that it’s called the Sand Demon. Yet when confronted by Hippowdon, Drapion keeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.

name: Darkrai

1.name: Shadow Cage
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Deino
flavour_text: It nests deep inside a cave. Food there is scarce, so Deino will sink its teeth into anything that moves and attempt to eat it.

name: Zweilous
flavour_text: The two heads have different likes and dislikes. Because the heads fight with each other, Zweilous gets stronger without needing to rely on others.

name: Hydreigon

ability.name: Roar in Unison
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may take 2 [D] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon. If you do, do 30 damage to this Pokémon.

1.name: Hyper Ray
1.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s said that Hydreigon grew ferocious because people in times long past loathed it, considering it to be evil incarnate and attacking it relentlessly.

name: Pangoro

1.name: Overdrive Smash
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overdrive Smash attack does +30 damage.

flavour_text: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Skrelp
flavour_text: This Pokémon is a poor swimmer. If it’s caught in a fierce storm, it will sometimes get washed far away and become unable to return to its home.

ability.name: Poison Point
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Mareanie

1.name: Poison Sting
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: It has excellent regenerative capabilities. Legs that a Mareanie has lost have a very bitter, astringent flavor—they’re not suitable as food.

name: Toxapex

1.name: Venoshock
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavour_text: Toxapex gets into fierce battles with Bruxish over areas where warm ocean currents flow, but the odds are always against it.

name: Impidimp
flavour_text: They live in groups, pestering and playing pranks on each other to polish their troublemaking skills.

name: Morgrem

1.name: False Surrender
1.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon absorbs negative emotions and turns them into energy. It’s popular with people who tend to think gloomy thoughts.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavour_text: It lives deep within the forest. Even after evolving into this splendid form, it hasn’t given up on its petty misdeeds and pranks.

name: Ferroseed
flavour_text: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn

1.name: Guard Press
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Durant

1.name: Bite Together
1.effect: If Durant is on your Bench, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

name: Cobalion

1.name: Sacred Sword
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword.

flavour_text: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

name: Honedge
flavour_text: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

name: Doublade
flavour_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash

ability.name: Cursed Metal
ability.effect: Attacks used by your [P] Pokémon and [M] Pokémon do +30 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

name: Meltan
flavour_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

2.name: Metal Arms
2.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 50 more damage.

name: Corviknight

1.name: Iron Wings
1.effect: Discard 2 [M] Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −50 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: Although its wings have partly turned to steel and become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies through the skies with ease.

name: Druddigon

1.name: Giga Claw
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Goomy

ability.name: Sticky Membrane
ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon cost 1 [C] more.

flavour_text: Goomy’s horns are excellent sensory organs that cover all five of Goomy’s senses. Goomy picks up on danger from the movement of the air.

name: Sliggoo
flavour_text: When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus coating its entire body becomes more concentrated— it’ll dissolve anything.

name: Goodra

1.name: Spiral Drain
1.effect: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is uncontrollable when enraged. It rampages on and on, lashing its tail with enough power to send a dump truck flying.

name: Pidgey
flavour_text: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

name: Pidgeotto
flavour_text: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Pidgeot

1.name: Twister
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

1.name: Wild Tackle
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

name: Eevee

ability.name: Boosted Evolution
ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, it can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Aipom

1.name: Tail Smash
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

name: Ambipom

1.name: Excited Tail
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. If this Pokémon has Lucky Mittens attached, flip 4 coins instead.

flavour_text: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that’s proof it really likes you.

name: Miltank

1.name: Body Slam
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

name: Zigzagoon
flavour_text: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

name: Linoone
flavour_text: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

name: Whismur
flavour_text: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.

name: Loudred
flavour_text: The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

name: Exploud

1.name: Booming Roar
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

flavour_text: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

name: Skitty

1.name: Play Rough
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty

ability.name: Search for Friends
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand.

flavour_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Spinda

1.name: Dizzying Headbutt
1.effect: Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.

flavour_text: Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!

flavour_text: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

flavour_text: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Chatot

1.name: Sleepy Song
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Patrat

name: Watchog

flavour_text: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Lillipup

1.effect: Draw a card.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

name: Herdier
flavour_text: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

name: Stoutland

1.name: Dangerous Bite
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavour_text: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

name: Rufflet
flavour_text: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

name: Braviary
flavour_text: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

name: Furfrou

ability.name: Fur Coat
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Rookidee

name: Corvisquire
flavour_text: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

name: Wooloo

1.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Dubwool

1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

flavour_text: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Beautifly

1.name: Skill Dive
1.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.

name: Skiddo
flavour_text: As long as it has sunlight and water, Skiddo can make energy with the leaves on its body, allowing it to live on rocky mountains barren of food.

name: Rillaboom

ability.name: Captivating Rhythm
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

flavour_text: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It’s very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Chandelure

ability.name: Slow Sear
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

flavour_text: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

name: Magikarp

1.name: Waterfall Evolution
1.effect: Put a random card from your deck that evolves from this Pokémon onto this Pokémon to evolve it.

flavour_text: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Ludicolo

1.name: Rhythmic Steps
1.effect: If you have exactly 1, 3, or 5 cards in your hand, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Jellicent

ability.name: Bouncy Body
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Keldeo

1.name: Sacred Sword
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword.

flavour_text: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Eiscue

ability.name: Ice Face
ability.effect: If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes −40 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: If you lick the ice covering its face, you’ll find it has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on ocean currents from a cold, faraway land.

name: Luxray

1.name: Flash Impact
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

name: Cofagrigus

1.name: Soul Shot
1.effect: Discard 2 cards from your hand. If you can't discard 2 cards, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

name: Gothita
flavour_text: Beware of touching the ribbon-shaped feelers that control its psychic power. Gothita will begin bawling if you do.

name: Makuhita
flavour_text: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hippowdon

1.name: Crashing Fangs

flavour_text: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

name: Archeops

name: Pancham
flavour_text: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Honchkrow

1.name: Evil Admonition

name: Rowlet

1.name: Skill Dive

1.name: Skill Dive

name: Moltres

1.name: Sky Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Litten

1.name: Heat Tackle
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat

1.name: Heat Tackle
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they’ve grown close, but it’s a powerful, sharp-clawed Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

name: Poliwag

1.name: Call for Family
1.effect: Put 1 random Poliwag from your deck onto your Bench.

flavour_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavour_text: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Poliwrath

ability.name: Counterattack
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

name: Articuno

1.name: Ice Beam
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Manaphy

1.name: Oceanic Gift
1.effect: Choose 2 of your Benched Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to that Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Popplio

1.name: Sing
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavour_text: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn’t know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Zapdos

1.name: Raging Thunder
1.effect: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Oricorio

ability.name: Safeguard
ability.effect: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex.

flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

name: Zeraora

ability.name: Thunderclap Flash
ability.effect: At the end of your first turn, take a [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Drowzee
flavour_text: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.

name: Hypno

ability.name: Sleep Pendulum
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

name: Geodude
flavour_text: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they’re totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

name: Graveler
flavour_text: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

name: Golem

1.name: Guard Press
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

name: Rockruff

1.name: Signs of Evolution
1.effect: Put a random card that evolves from Rockruff from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavour_text: The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon’s habitat caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

name: Meowth

1.name: Pay Day
1.effect: Draw 1 card.

flavour_text: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Persian

1.name: Shadow Claw
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

flavour_text: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Doduo
flavour_text: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Dodrio
flavour_text: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.

name: Bidoof

flavour_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

flavour_text: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Sunkern
flavour_text: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

name: Sunflora

name: Burmy

name: Mothim
flavour_text: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon

ability.name: Ignition
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may take a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to your Active [R] Pokémon.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Granbull

name: Lampent

name: Chandelure

name: Pumpkaboo

name: Gourgeist

1.effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.

name: Boldore

name: Tyrantrum

flavour_text: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Smoliv

1.name: Nutrients
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Charcadet
flavour_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Tatsugiri

1.name: Rally Back
1.effect: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Frigibax

1.name: Stiffen
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Tinkaton

1.name: Gigaton Hammer
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Gigaton Hammer.

flavour_text: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Pawmi

1.name: Random Spark
1.effect: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Paldean Clodsire

1.name: Muddy Hammer
1.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

flavour_text: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

2.name: Diving Icicles
2.effect: Discard all [W] Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 130 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Electrike

1.name: Reckless Charge
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Varoom

1.name: Poison Gas
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Haxorus

1.name: Frenzied Blade
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

flavour_text: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.

name: Chatot

1.name: Spinning Draw
1.effect: Draw a card.

flavour_text: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can’t stop touching it.

name: Victini

ability.name: Victory Star
ability.effect: Once during your turn, after you flip any coins for an attack of 1 of your [R] Pokémon, you may ignore all results of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again. You can't use more than 1 Victory Star Ability each turn.

flavour_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Meloetta

ability.name: Strange Singing
ability.effect: At the beginning of your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put a random [P] Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Zygarde
flavour_text: Born when around 10% of Zygarde’s cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

name: Zygarde

1.name: Cell Storm
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

name: Eevee

ability.name: Boosted Evolution
ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, it can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

1.name: Land Laser
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

name: Castform Sunny Form

1.name: Sunny Scorching
1.effect: If a Stadium is in play, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavour_text: Castform changes to this form when it basks in bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin, it feels all dried out!

name: Tepig

1.name: Firebreathing
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is a ravenous glutton. It uses its excellent sense of smell to find food, then cooks it to a crisp before eating.

name: Dwebble

ability.name: Shell Armor
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −10 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Zarude

1.name: Dark Vengeance
1.effect: If any of your [D] Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavour_text: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Treecko
flavour_text: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

name: Gallade

1.name: Earthen Sword
1.effect: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavour_text: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

name: Charcadet

1.name: Protect
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Vaporeon

1.name: Impound
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away into water.

1.name: Shimmering Slash
